authNote: Grok Bot docs say a bot can add an MCP server by public URL or by a command that runs on the bot's own computer, then complete authentication. They do not publish the connector form's header name. The Grok API remote-MCP parameter `authorization` is documented to be sent as Authorization: Bearer, but that is a different API surface and is not a substitute for this bot. This server fail-closes unless Authorization: Bearer matches BOT_WORKER_TOKEN.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs a worker may claim. Drafts and other staff's private edits are omitted.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch one worker-visible job, including geometry, the versioned layout spec, and artifact status. Does not include file bytes.

tools.name: claim_job
tools.description: Take a lease on a dispatched job, or replace an expired lease. Refuses an active lease.

tools.name: create_source_download
tools.description: Read one mockup or vector through the authenticated MCP connection. Small files are returned inline. A signed URL is added only when APP_ORIGIN is a public https origin.

tools.name: create_artifact_upload
tools.description: Mint a one-time upload grant for print_png, print_pdf, or proof_png. POST the bytes to uploadUrl with Authorization: Bearer grantToken. The server never fetches a URL.

tools.name: complete_job
tools.description: Mark a leased job complete after all three artifacts exist. Idempotent. Refuses a failed job.

tools.name: fail_job
tools.description: Mark a leased job failed. Idempotent. Refuses a completed job.
